title: Charvarius Ward: I didn't want to finish my career like I finished last season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Charvarius Ward: I didn't want to finish my career like I finished last season
sources.description: Colts cornerback Charvarius Ward considered retiring from the NFL at the end of the 2025 season, but he opted to go the other way and returned for a second season with the club.
